review_locator: PMCID:PMC2623245, Methods for Identifying Novel Integrin Ligands; PMCID:PMC3115772, Integrins and cadherins join forces to form adhesive networks
primary_title: Identification of a binding site for integrin alphaEbeta7 in the N-terminal domain of E-cadherin; Molecular basis for leukocyte integrin alpha(E)beta(7) adhesion to epithelial (E)-cadherin
decision_basis: The integrin/cadherin reviews cite primary studies showing that E-cadherin is a direct counter-receptor for alphaEbeta7, with binding localized to the N-terminal extracellular domain and alphaEbeta7-dependent lymphocyte adhesion.
limitations_preserved: Preserve E-cadherin N-terminal extracellular binding site, alphaEbeta7 heterodimer, epithelial/intraepithelial-lymphocyte context, and divalent-cation/T-cell-activation dependence; no SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC8755661, The F11 Receptor (F11R)/Junctional Adhesion Molecule-A (JAM-A) in cancer progression; PMCID:PMC7723963, Targeting Opposing Immunological Roles of the Junctional Adhesion Molecule-A in Autoimmunity and Cancer
primary_title: JAM-1 is a ligand of the beta(2) integrin LFA-1 involved in transendothelial migration of leukocytes; The functional interaction of the beta 2 integrin lymphocyte function-associated antigen-1 with junctional adhesion molecule-A is mediated by the I domain
decision_basis: The JAM-A reviews cite primary studies identifying JAM-A as a counter-receptor for LFA-1 and showing direct I-domain-mediated adhesion, arrest, and transendothelial migration of leukocytes.
limitations_preserved: Preserve JAM-A membrane-proximal D2 domain, LFA-1 alphaLbeta2 heterodimer and I-domain activation state, endothelial/leukocyte transmigration context; no autonomous F11R intracellular relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7073085, beta2 Integrins—Multi-Functional Leukocyte Receptors in Health and Disease; PMCID:PMC2990789, Leukocyte integrins and their ligand interactions
primary_title: alphadbeta2 integrin is expressed on human eosinophils and functions as an alternative ligand for vascular cell adhesion molecule 1 (VCAM-1); The leukocyte integrin alpha D beta 2 binds VCAM-1: evidence for a binding interface between I domain and VCAM-1
decision_basis: The beta2-integrin reviews cite primary studies showing that alphaDbeta2 is an alternative VCAM-1 ligand, with direct VCAM-1 binding and VCAM-1-dependent eosinophil or lymphoid-cell adhesion.
limitations_preserved: Preserve alphaDbeta2 as an alternative beta2-integrin ligand, VCAM-1 D40/interface and activation-state context, eosinophil/lymphoid adhesion models; no SCI inference.
